A simpler shared inbox for small teams

JellyShared inboxCurrent

JAJames A.ArchiveELabel

  1. EX

    Exciting <hello@exciting.io>

    to: you

    Jul 10, 2024

    Jelly is a shared inbox for team email addresses like support@your-team.com.

    Everyone on the team can see what’s come in, assign conversations to each other, leave internal notes out of sight of customers, and follow along without being cc’d on everything. It’s one flat price for the whole team, with no per-seat fees, because teams work best when everyone is included.

    4 attachments

    • Jelly’s inbox: conversations grouped into Brand new, Mine and Assigned to someone else, with a “Who’s got this?” button on a new message
    • A Jelly conversation: teammates chatting underneath a customer’s email, out of sight of the customer, above a Reply button
    • Assigning a conversation to a teammate in Jelly
    • Jelly’s activity view

    I’d wanted to build a shared inbox like Jelly for more than ten years. When I joined Good Enough, I brought the idea with me, and we built it there together. The team needed a better way to handle their own shared addresses than the workarounds and bloated help desks they’d been putting up with, and Jelly was the result.

    When Good Enough restructured, we decided that, since I had the expertise, the best thing for Jelly was for me to keep running it. So Jelly now lives here at Exciting, and I’m very grateful to everyone at Good Enough for helping to bring it into the world.
